status: root-reviewed computational amendment; commit before corrected outcomes; scientific claim remains proposed and inconclusive
exposure: FULL: founding England results, Stage1 and integration review already seen. Same exposed matrices; exploratory correction, not confirmation.
scope: Correct C1 population, library separation, neighbourhood construction and marginal/matched effect scales only. Original Stage1 bytes are preserved. No new C2/C3/C4/C5, no reference-gene null comparison, no claim closure or grade change.

population.fixed_set: All original cells_table rows in the two primary libraries with primary_include=True and gate_transition=True; use the full cell table, not the round2-labelled subset.
population.gate: Cldn4,Ndrg1,Sox9: at least two detected; retain original definition and verify from summed raw symbol counts.
population.inclusion: Original hash-verified primary_include, including original doublet exclusions and immune-low-anchor rule; no recomputation of doublet flags.
population.row_order: sort each library by exact barcode; unique (gsm,barcode) joins
population.fixed_group: Cd177 summed raw UMIs >=1 versus 0; retain same positives/negative candidate pool for marginal and all k values
population.floor: at least 30 positives and 30 negatives per library; no cell inclusion or gate relaxation

input_provenance.raw_files: six original matrix/feature/barcode files; verify against historical continuation preparation run before reading values
input_provenance.matrix_route: Read original verified raw triplets and select exact fixed barcodes. Reconstruct sums and detected features; compare totals/n_genes, Cd177 call, transition gate and scores to cached values after commit. Do not depend on unhashed Stage1 direct npz/barcode inputs.
input_provenance.duplicates: sum raw counts for duplicated gene symbols before endpoint scoring; exclude all feature rows carrying a banned symbol from neighbourhood construction

neighbourhood.space: New locally fitted, deterministic per-library PCA within the fixed transition population; this amends the original integrated-space wording and is not a reconstruction of the author embedding.
neighbourhood.excluded_genes: Cd177 plus every gate, every module, every individual gene, epithelial anchor, immune/non-epithelial panel gene from the frozen England continuation contract, plus Retnlg; see config/excluded_genes.tsv.
neighbourhood.normalization: log1p(10000 * raw count / sum of ALL non-mitochondrial, non-excluded raw counts in that cell); denominator is computed after all exclusions, before variable-gene selection. Tested genes cannot enter through the library denominator.
neighbourhood.feature_selection: within each library, genes detected in >=3 fixed cells and variance>0; select at most 2000 by population variance of normalized log values, descending, ties by symbol. No group labels or outcomes enter selection.
neighbourhood.fit: center columns without variance scaling; deterministic full SVD with one BLAS thread; retain min(20,n_cells-1,n_features-1) PCs; refuse fewer than 5 usable PCs; no whitening, integration, UMAP, clusters or outcome-driven dimension choices
neighbourhood.depth_strata: four equal-count quartiles of remaining-gene raw library sum, ranked by (sum,barcode) within the fixed library; group/outcome genes excluded from these sums
neighbourhood.matching: for each positive, k nearest Cd177-negative cells in the SAME library and depth quartile by Euclidean distance in retained PCs; deterministic ties by negative barcode; k=5,10,20; primary k=10; matching with replacement across positives
neighbourhood.no_hidden_population_change: Require every fixed positive to have k candidates; otherwise that entire library/k is not assessed. Never drop positives to salvage a match. Require >=30 unique matched negative controls; report reused-control frequencies and effective control sample size, without interpreting them as biological replicates.
neighbourhood.quality_outputs: feature list and loading/coordinate hashes; remaining library sums and depth strata; nearest-neighbour edge list, distances, selected controls, unique-control counts and weight ESS; per-PC group standardized differences before/after matching. No quality threshold chosen after outcomes.

outcomes.definition: Unchanged frozen module membership; per-cell mean log1p(full-library CP10k) across present genes, Itga2 individual log1p(full-library CP10k); >=70 percent coverage and individual Itga2 present. Gene values/membership never enter neighbourhood or depth strata.
outcomes.instrument_parity: raw-count reconstructed endpoints must equal the cached per-cell scores within 1e-8; totals and group/gate calls must agree exactly; stop on mismatch

estimands.marginal: mean outcome fixed Cd177-positive cells minus mean outcome all fixed negative cells, per library
estimands.matched: mean across ALL fixed positives of (positive outcome minus mean outcome of its k matched controls), per library
estimands.common_scale: Report raw log1p(CP10k) differences and divide BOTH marginal and matched differences by the SAME sample SD of that endpoint across the complete fixed library population; label fixed-population standardized difference, not original pooled-group SMD. No ratio interpreted as biological fraction.
estimands.C3: Do not apply old Stage1 marginal C3 null bands to these matched estimates. No marker-specificity/null-tail conclusion is computed.
estimands.inference: No pooling libraries, confidence intervals, p values, cell-bootstrap biological inference, mechanism claim, or attribution of ambient origin. Animal identities are unavailable.
estimands.decision: Describe change from marginal to gene-excluded-neighbourhood-matched effect and its k sensitivity separately for each library. A residual or its attenuation cannot close A16 biologically.

verification: committed spec and exclusion list hashes plus historical raw/cell-table provenance
fixed cell set, original total counts, grouping and gate parity
all banned genes absent from latent features; no use of saved endpoints for feature selection or matching
synthetic perturbation of excluded gene columns leaves latent inputs and depth strata unchanged
no match crosses library/depth stratum; every eligible positive retained for each assessed k
recalculate estimates from persisted edge weights and cell outcomes; common denominators identical across marginal and k
execution_gate: Root reviews and commits this amendment and excluded-gene list before any corrected outcome calculation. A separate execution script must record that commit and refuse a changed spec.
